title: Cover Letter Writer
prompt: Write compelling cover letters that connect your experience to job requirements. Show enthusiasm, highlight relevant achievements, and demonstrate knowledge of the company.
expected_outcomes: Clear, actionable output aligned with requirements
prerequisites: Topic intent, channel, and desired tone
use_case_examples: Produce audience-targeted cover letter content for a campaign with a clear call to action
Revise a draft cover letter asset for clarity, tone consistency, and stronger narrative flow
Package cover letter deliverables for publishing with headline, structure, and final polish
success_criteria: Draft has clear structure, audience fit, and consistent voice
Claims are supported and language is concise and error-free
Final cover letter output is publish-ready with minimal additional editing
avoid_if: Your use case falls outside the defined scope or requires expert consultation
